title: GOV-0043: Gate 05 declared but unenforced — no per-type rules, schemas, or example for threat-model/privacy-assessment/supply-chain-plan/security-approval
problem:
## Observed
G05 (Security, privacy and AI safety; owner `security_authority`, min C2) is the next declared-but-unenforced gate after G04. `lifecycle.json` lists G05's four `required_evidence` types — **threat-model, privacy-assessment, supply-chain-plan, security-approval** — yet `validate_evidence` has no per-type rule for any of them, no G05 example, and none of the four schemas. A G05 dossier today would pass on names alone.

## Expected
The four G05 types get per-type rules in `validate_evidence`, each mapping to a G05 exit criterion (the gate OPENS each artifact):
- `threat-model` — every threat/abuse case carries a **mitigation** ("threats and abuse cases controlled"); an uncontrolled threat is refused.
- `privacy-assessment` — every data category carries a **lawful basis** and **handling** ("privacy obligations addressed").
- `supply-chain-plan` — **secret controls** are declared and every dependency carries a **control** ("dependency and secret controls planned").
- `security-approval` — a **human `security_authority`** approval, **digest-bound to the threat-model**, with a named **residual-risk owner** ("residual risk owned").
Plus `examples/gate-dossier.G05.json` (C2, validated in CI beside G00-G04) and a **G04->G05** pair-acceptance (the full G00->G05 chain).

## Evidence
- G05 required_evidence = [threat-model, privacy-assessment, supply-chain-plan, security-approval]; enforced of 4 -> 0; no G05 example; no schemas
- G05 minimum_change_class is C2, so the example dossier carries the four C2 authority roles

## Unknowns
None for the gate contract. This WP is the deterministic G05 evidence contract; a `badf-security` authoring skill is a later WP if a real task needs it.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0060` (G05). Four `check_*` + registration; four schemas; `examples/gate-dossier.G05.json` + its four evidence/artifact pairs; `tests/test_badf_g05.py` failing-first + a G04->G05 pair-acceptance; mutation; own G07 self-dossier. C2.
